name: coldguard
description: ColdGuard — real-time cold-chain telemetry monitoring (MERNIFY hackathon)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web,sim -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w simulator"
scripts.demo: npm run db:up && npm run seed && npm run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w simulator && npm run typecheck -w loadtest
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
